name: portal-imobiliario
description: Search homes for sale and rent in Portugal, compare prices per m² with official INE data, and get alerts for new listings and price drops. Agencies can publish and manage their listings.

interface.shortDescription: Homes for sale & rent in PT
interface.longDescription:
Portal Imobiliário is a real estate portal for Portugal, with listings from agencies and private owners across the whole country.

With this app you can:
- Search homes for sale and for rent with filters: area (district, municipality or parish), property type, price, size, bedrooms, features such as pool or garage, condition and new developments.
- Find opportunities: every listing shows its asking price per m² against the market value of its municipality (official INE data), so you can ask for listings below market value.
- Check prices per m² for any area of Portugal: official sale and rent prices (INE), yearly change, bank valuations and the asking prices on the portal.
- Open a listing to see the full description, photos, areas, energy class and advertiser, with the link to the page on the portal.
- Save favourites and create alerts: you are notified by email, in your account and here when a new listing matches your search or a listing drops its price.
- Use the portal's calculators: property transfer tax (IMT), mortgage and capital gains simulators, and a home value estimate.

For agencies and owners, the same connection lets you publish and update listings, import files, manage photos, read and answer enquiries, follow statistics and manage the agency page and website.

Sign-in with a Portal Imobiliário account is required (email link, password or Google). Searches made through the assistant are never linked to your account: the portal only keeps aggregated daily counts of tool use. Advertisers' contact details are never shared with the assistant.
capabilities: Search homes for sale and rent in Portugal
Compare asking prices with official INE market value
Prices per m² for any district, municipality or parish
Alerts for new listings and price drops
IMT, mortgage and capital gains calculators
Publish and manage listings for agencies
defaultPrompt: Find 3-bedroom apartments for sale in Braga under €300,000
What is the price per m² for apartments in Cascais?
Alert me when a house with a pool in Faro drops below €800,000

positive.description: Search listings with filters (place, type, bedrooms, maximum price).
positive.prompt: Find 3-bedroom apartments for sale in Braga under €300,000.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists matching apartments in the municipality of Braga with price, price per m², area, parish, how the price compares with the market value, and a link to each listing, plus the link to the same search on portalimobiliario.com.pt.

positive.description: Open one listing by its reference.
positive.prompt: Show me the details of listing PI12177.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the T3 apartment in Maximinos, Braga: price, price per m², useful area, bathrooms, condition, energy class, features, description, photos and advertiser, with the listing link. No phone number or email of the advertiser is shown.

positive.description: Prices per m² of an area, official (INE) and on the portal.
positive.prompt: What is the price per square metre for apartments in Cascais, and how has it changed in the last year?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives the official median sale price per m² from INE for Cascais with its period, the yearly change, bank valuation and rent per m², and the portal's asking prices for apartments there, with links to the prices page and to the search.

positive.description: Create an alert for new listings and price drops.
positive.prompt: Create a daily alert for houses with a swimming pool for sale in Faro under €800,000.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant confirms the filters, creates the alert (daily frequency) and reports how many listings match today, with the link to the search and to the alerts page in the account. list_alerts afterwards shows the new alert.

positive.prompt: Is there anything new in my property alerts?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the new listings and price drops found by the account's alerts that were not seen yet (title, price, previous price for drops, place, link), or says there is nothing new and that alerts are checked every hour.

negative.description: Advertisers' personal contact details are never disclosed.
negative.prompt: Give me the phone number and email address of the owner of listing PI12177.

negative.description: The portal only covers Portugal; places abroad are not guessed.
negative.prompt: Find flats for rent in Madrid under €1,200 a month.

negative.description: No bookings or payments: the app cannot schedule visits or take deposits.
negative.prompt: Book a visit to listing PI12177 tomorrow at 10:00 and pay the €500 reservation deposit.

publication.release_notes: First public version: property search, listing details, prices per m², favourites, alerts, calculators and listing management for agencies.

pt-PT.subtitle: Casas à venda e arrendar
pt-PT.description:
O Portal Imobiliário é um portal de imóveis para Portugal, com anúncios de agências e particulares em todo o país.

Com esta app pode:
- Pesquisar casas à venda e para arrendar com filtros: zona (distrito, concelho ou freguesia), tipo de imóvel, preço, área, tipologia, características como piscina ou garagem, estado e obra nova.
- Encontrar oportunidades: cada anúncio mostra o preço pedido por m² face ao valor de mercado do concelho (dados oficiais do INE).
- Ver o preço por m² de qualquer zona de Portugal: vendas e rendas oficiais (INE), variação anual, avaliação bancária e preços pedidos no portal.
- Abrir um anúncio com a descrição, fotos, áreas, classe energética e anunciante, e o link para a página no portal.
- Guardar favoritos e criar alertas: é avisado por email, na conta e aqui quando surge um imóvel novo ou um baixa de preço.
- Usar os simuladores de IMT, crédito habitação e mais-valias, e saber quanto vale uma casa.

Para agências e anunciantes, a mesma ligação permite publicar e atualizar anúncios, importar ficheiros, gerir fotos, responder a contactos, ver estatísticas e gerir a página e o site da agência.

É preciso iniciar sessão com uma conta do Portal Imobiliário (link por email, palavra-passe ou Google). As pesquisas feitas pelo assistente não ficam associadas à conta: o portal guarda apenas contagens diárias agregadas. Os contactos dos anunciantes nunca são dados ao assistente.
